newsitem.title: BELARUS: Belarus Q1 sugar refining slips yr/yr to 17,758 T.
newsitem.headline: Belarus Q1 sugar refining slips yr/yr to 17,758 T.

text.p: The former Soviet republic of Belarus refined 17,758 tonnes of sugar in the first quarter of this year compared to 18,065 tonnes over the same period in 1996, the Statistics Ministry said on Monday.
Total refined sugar output in March was 10,284 tonnes against 11,032 tonnes a year ago.
The Economy Ministry recently ordered Belarus's four refineries to produce 150,000 tonnes this year.
Belarussian domestic demand for refined sugar is about 250,000 to 300,000 tonnes a year. --Kiev Newsroom +380 44 244 9150
